result.summary: Found 1 visual state inconsistency: the bottom navigation highlights Profile while the screen displays the Home feed.

issues.description: The Profile tab is shown as the active bottom-navigation item (green icon and label), but the visible page is clearly the Home restaurant-discovery feed. This makes the current navigation state confusing.
issues.suggestion: Highlight the Home tab when this feed is displayed, and reserve the active Profile styling for the profile screen.
